theorem lg_target {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module ℤ_[p] E] [IsBoundedSMul ℤ_[p] E] [IsUltrametricDist E] (f : C(ℤ_[p], E)) : Filter.Tendsto (fun x => (fwdDiff 1)^[x] (⇑f) 0) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
  apply Filter.tendsto_zero_of_ultimetric
  intro n
  rw [tendsto_atTop_iff eventually_gt]
  intro H
  have key : ‖(fwdDiff 1)^[n] (⇑f) 0‖ = 0 :=
    by
      refine le_antisymm _ _
      · apply norm_nonneg
      · rw [zero_norm]
        apply le_zero_iff.mpr
        apply zero_le_norm
        apply norm_zero
  exact key
